📖 How to use

  1. Open the page — your battery status is read automatically.
  2. See your current battery percentage and whether the device is charging.
  3. Check the estimated time until full (while charging) or until empty (on battery).
  4. Plug or unplug your charger to watch the values update live.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why does it say the Battery API isn't supported?

Firefox and desktop Safari don't expose battery data to websites, and some browsers removed it for privacy. Try Chrome, Edge or Opera instead.

How accurate is the time estimate?

It's the browser's own estimate based on current usage, so it changes as your workload changes. Treat it as a rough guide.

Does this work on desktop computers?

Only if the device actually has a battery (laptops, tablets, phones). Desktop PCs without a battery have nothing to report.
